about: Public-domain photos (U.S. government works: NASA) of twenty people, several each, from Wikimedia Commons, used to measure whether MetaRush tells faces apart (docs/visual-index.md, D73, D114). Twenty people of similar backgrounds make the test harder (astronauts of the same years, portraits under the same lights, work photos on the space station). Each photo shows one clear face (chosen by MetaRush's own face finder: no other face even a quarter of its size) and was checked by eye against its title. Files are downloaded at run time, never committed.
